category: Clear active switch thumb over two observed track states

background_estimate.method: Symmetric vector capsule fitted from resting-track outer contours; active-frame color measured from exposed track. Distant unoccluded RGB is copied; hidden/halo-adjacent input is modeled.
background_estimate.limits: Track symmetry, hidden color uniformity and separation from the thumb shadow are assumptions. Conditional rendering scores are not proof of complete photographic background recovery or proprietary Apple optics.

resting_track_fits.method: Outer half-contrast contour of the resting track; fit symmetric capsule, four pose/size parameters.

exposed_track_fit.method: Active-frame exposed end-cap circle; hidden end mirrored about the measured resting track center.

background: Direct distant source pixels plus explicit symmetric-capsule track estimate from exposed geometry/color. No complete photographic recovery claim.
identifiability: Two actual on/off transition frames; observed size/pose differs. Shared normalized optics/material are tested after single-frame fitting. Hidden track symmetry, color uniformity and dynamic contact-state equivalence remain assumptions.
